meta.problem: Russ and Jaime are buying bulk candy at the store.  The candy is sold by the pound. Use the number line to find out which student has less candy.

hintsPerCorrectStep: What is the fraction that should be placed on this number line? Divide the number line by entering the number of divisions to make, and press OK.
The fraction 9/8 should be placed here. What is the denominator? Use the denominator to evenly divide the number line.
Enter 8 into the box and press OK.
Click on the spot where the first fraction would be on this number line.
What is the numerator of the fraction 9/8? The numerator represents the number of parts you should count.
Count 9 part(s) from the left and click on the spot.
What is the fraction that should be placed on this number line? Divide the number line by entering the number of divisions to make, and press OK.
The fraction 11/10 should be placed here. What is the denominator? Use the denominator to evenly divide the number line.
Enter 10 into the box and press OK.
Click on the spot where the second fraction would be on this number line.
What is the numerator of the fraction 11/10? The numerator represents the number of parts you should count.
Count 11 part(s) from the left and click on the spot.
Choose the correct statement from the choices. What are you looking for? The larger or smaller fraction?
You are looking for the fraction that is smaller. Look at the fractions you placed on the number lines, which one is smaller?
The smaller fraction is placed on the number line for the Pound of Jaime's candy.
Click on the highlighted element and select 'Jaime has less candy.'
You are done! Click on the "done" button to finish.
